name: David Kinskey
education: B.A. in economics, Harvard College, 1979; J.D., University of Wyoming College of Law, 1982
prior_offices: Wyoming Senate District 22, 2014–2024; Mayor of Sheridan, 2004–2014
background: David (Dave) Kinskey of Sheridan served in the Wyoming Senate from 2014 to 2024, representing Senate District 22. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born Sept. 22, 1956; listed a B.A. in economics from Harvard College (1979) and a J.D. from the University of Wyoming College of Law (1982); and identified him as an attorney and businessperson. It also listed service as mayor of Sheridan from 2004 to 2014, and said he was married to his wife, Donna, and had three children and three grandchildren.

sources.name: Wyoming Trucking Association and Associated General Contractors of Wyoming, 2021–2022 Directory of the Sixty-Sixth Legislature
